sloka: अतीत्य मार्गं सहसा महात्मा स तत्र रक्षोधिपपादमूले ।ददर्श राज्ञः परिचारवृद्धान् गृहं महारत्नविभूषितं च ।। ५.४८.५८।।।।
transliteration: atītya mārgaṁ sahasā mahātmā sa tatra rakṣodhipapādamūle ।dadarśa rājñaḥ paricāravṛddhān gṛhaṁ mahāratnavibhūṣitaṁ ca ।। 5.48.58।।।।

translations.english: Resplendent Ravana saw the ogres of ugly appearance dragging the foremost of the monkeys here and there.
